name: Golwg

attributes.attribute: Welsh heroine also called Golwg Haffddydd
maidservant to Esyllt who became the lover of a friend of Trystan
later name of the maid in the Tristan and Iseult form of the tale

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Golwg, also called Golwg Haffddydd, is a Welsh heroine. She appears in early Arthurian legend as the maidservant to Esyllt. She later became the lover of a friend of Trystan. When the tale becomes Tristan and Iseult, the maid carries the name Brangien.

okr.objective: Record Golwg as the Arthurian maidservant to Esyllt who later emerged as Brangien.
key_results: Golwg was the maidservant to Esyllt in early Arthurian legend.
She became the lover of a friend of Trystan.
In the Tristan and Iseult form the maid takes the name Brangien.
